title: Signed-Item Authentication Audit Trail
dataSources: Collection items (`collection:item`), intake scans (`collection:scan`), market prices (`collection:price`), item photos (`collection:photo`), authentication records (`collection:auth`), loans (`collection:loan`), and condition audits (`collection:condition`).
app: Collection telemetry from personal catalogues, NFC scans, pricing feeds, authentication records, loan logs, shelf measurements, and item-condition audits streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=collection:auth
| stats latest(status) as status latest(last_verified_by) as last_verified_by by item_id collection_type
| sort status
description: Summarises the latest authentication state and verifier for autographed or otherwise high-trust items.
value: Authentication history adds confidence and resale value, but only if the evidence trail stays organized.
implementation: Log every verification or recheck with the item identifier, status, and who performed or supplied the verification.
visualization: Table of authentication status and last verifier by item.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks which signed or special items have been checked for authenticity and who last verified them.
